t.E422.agn: In 2017 EFSA saw no need for a numerical acceptable daily intake (ADI) and found no safety concern at the reported uses.
t.E422.body: Glycerol occurs naturally in the body as a building block of fats and is used for energy.
t.E422.eval: It may be obtained from vegetable or animal fats.
t.E422.prod: It is obtained by splitting vegetable oils with water at high pressure, by saponification, or as a by-product of biodiesel production, and is purified by distillation; EU manufacturers reported using only vegetable oils. Chemical synthesis from propylene and fermentation routes are also described in the literature.
t.E422.regx.0: Re-evaluated; no numerical ADI needed, no safety concern.
t.E422.summary: A sweetish, syrupy liquid also known as glycerine. It is a humectant; it prevents drying out in confectionery, cakes and dried fruit.
t.E422.what: It retains moisture and provides softness and slight sweetness.
